Udacity Data Analyst project: Explore Weather Trends.

Local temperature trends in a global context

Compare Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City temperature histories with global trends.

Python · pandas · Matplotlib

The question

Long-term local variation is easier to understand alongside a global baseline.

The work

  • Prepare local and global temperature series.
  • Use moving averages to compare longer-term patterns.
  • Visualize the series and their associations.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Original analysis includes a multi-series trend chart and correlation heatmap.

What I learned

  • Use smoothing and common reference points to make time-series comparisons readable.

Project context

  • Exploratory teaching analysis, not a climate attribution study.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
